step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled NMOS pair with a diode-connected NMOS tail that functions as a differential envelope detector. It rectifies a differential RF input into a DC voltage shift at the common source node, tracking the envelope of the RF signal.

paper_reference.title: A Super-Regenerative Radio on Plastic Based on Thin-Film Transistors and Antennas on Large Flexible Sheets for Distributed Communication Links

detector_gain.description: Voltage conversion efficiency (DC shift / RF amplitude)

sky130_expected.calculation: With 0.9V DC bias, V_N2 shifts from ~0.45V to ~0.4V for a 0.5V RF amplitude. Gain = (0.4 - 0.45) / 0.5 = -0.1 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cross-coupled pair pulls the output towards the lower of the two inputs, creating a negative DC shift proportional to the RF amplitude.

v_out_dc.description: DC output voltage without RF input

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the voltage divider formed by the cross-coupled pair and the diode-connected load.

power_dc.description: DC power consumption from the bias sources

sky130_expected.reasoning: Low power consumption due to the low overdrive voltage of the transistors at 0.9V bias.

sky130_expected.calculation: Cgs + Cgd for W=5u, L=0.5u. C_ox ≈ 5fF/um2. C ≈ 2/3 * 5 * 0.5 * 5fF ≈ 8.3fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 devices are much smaller than TFTs, resulting in fF range capacitance instead of pF.

step3_testbench.description: Measures input capacitance via AC analysis, and envelope detector gain, DC output, and power consumption via Transient analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Envelope Detector Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N0 N1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 N0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Load capacitor to smooth the envelope
Cload N2 GND 10p

* Bias and RF sources (0.9V DC bias, 0.5V amplitude, 100MHz)
V0 N0 GND dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.5 100Meg 500n 0 0)
V1 N1 GND dc 0.9 ac -1 sin(0.9 0.5 100Meg 500n 0 180)

.control
  * AC Analysis for Input Capacitance
  ac dec 10 1Meg 1G
  let omega = 2 * pi * frequency
  let c_in = -imag(i(V0)) / omega
  meas ac c_in_100m find c_in at=100Meg
  print c_in_100m

  * Transient Analysis for Envelope Detection
  tran 1n 1.5u
  
  * Measure DC baseline (before RF starts at 500ns)
  meas tran v_n2_dc avg v(n2) from=100n to=400n
  meas tran i_v0_dc avg i(V0) from=100n to=400n
  meas tran i_v1_dc avg i(V1) from=100n to=400n
  let p_dc = - (i_v0_dc + i_v1_dc) * 0.9
  
  * Measure RF rectified output (after settling)
  meas tran v_n2_rf avg v(n2) from=1.1u to=1.4u
  
  * Calculate Detector Gain
  let detector_gain = (v_n2_rf - v_n2_dc) / 0.5
  
  print v_n2_dc
  print p_dc
  print v_n2_rf
  print detector_gain
  
  quit
.endc
.end
